Chapter 1148 - 14: Influence Diffusion (Subscription Requested)

Chapter 1148: Chapter 14: Influence Diffusion (Subscription Requested)

"Hahaha, Black Light, I’m going in too."

Wild Barbarian Great Saint appeared instantly before the entrance of the Xuanhuang Universe, then strode inside.

Lin Yuan’s slap forced the Black Light Domain of Black Light Great Saint to retract, unable to suppress time and space any longer, allowing Wild Barbarian Great Saint to teleport to the entrance.

Whoosh, whoosh, whoosh.

The next moment.

Tian Lu Great Saint, Shadow Demon Great Saint, and the following six Great Saints entered the Xuanhuang Universe one after another.

Black Light Great Saint was dizzy from Lin Yuan’s slap, giving the last six Great Saints a chance to enter the Xuanhuang Universe ahead.

Originally, these Great Saints were destined to enter the Xuanhuang Universe after the fifth position, but Black Light Great Saint being slapped away collectively boosted their entry by one rank.

"We....."

The many Chaos Venerables spectating from afar were immediately tempted, now losing the suppression of time and space, even the weakest Chaos Venerable could teleport to the entrance then go in.

The conflicts among Dual Origin Great Saint, Black Light Great Saint, and the other four Great Saints made them realize the extraordinariness of this Postnatal Universe.

Then, before any Chaos Venerable could take action.

Swish, swish.

An incomparably dark aura spread madly in all directions, Black Light Great Saint came to his senses, his invisible Black Light Domain began to spread wildly.

"Damn!" Black Light Great Saint felt extremely aggrieved, "Dual Origin tricked me."

Black Light Great Saint finally understood, Dual Origin Great Saint had no means to hold Lin Yuan for long, or even if there were, he wouldn’t use them.

As long as Dual Origin Great Saint could enter first, it was fine.

As for Black Light Great Saint? Entering later, Dual Origin Great Saint might have one less competitor.

Boom!

Black Light Great Saint almost simultaneously appeared beside the entrance to the Xuanhuang Universe.

As for the many Chaos Venerables who were originally eager, they suddenly became very obedient, not approaching unless Black Light Great Saint went in.

Earlier, when Black Light Great Saint was slapped away, some Chaos Venerables had red eyes, but on second thought, even if they entered the Xuanhuang Universe first, what could they achieve?

Tian Lu Great Saint and other six Great Saints had dared to enter first because they, too, were Great Saints, having at least the confidence to save their lives against Black Light Great Saint.

But these Chaos Venerables? Facing an enraged Black Light Great Saint? What could they do to resist?

If they entered the Xuanhuang Universe one step earlier and provoked Black Light Great Saint to chase them in anger, who could survive leaving this universe?

After cooling down, all the Venerables naturally knew what to do.

"I’ve suffered a huge loss this time."

Before entering the Xuanhuang Universe, Black Light Great Saint felt regret.

If he hadn’t cooperated with Dual Origin Great Saint, he could have entered as the third, vying for the second.

And now?

He’s the tenth to enter the universe.

If he hadn’t come to his senses last, a few Venerables might have entered the universe before him.

"I hope it’s not too late; this Postnatal Universe was left by Xuanhuang Great Saint from tens of thousands of Cosmic Eras ago..." Black Light Great Saint’s figure disappeared, entering the universe.

Like Dual Origin Great Saint, Black Light Great Saint knew some details about this universe, aware of how strong Xuanhuang Great Saint was back then.

A supreme Great Saint who, single-handedly, established an empire across tens of thousands of Void Domains, if not for an unexpected incident causing Xuanhuang Great Saint to mysteriously disappear mid-way, in future Cosmic Eras, Xuanhuang Great Saint could very likely have become the legendary Invincible Great Saint.

To become an Invincible Great Saint not only requires sweeping strength over other supreme Great Saints but also time to prove oneself, making other supreme Great Saints admit defeat.

And that requires long years.

Yet Xuanhuang Great Saint? At his peak, suddenly disappeared, causing him not to be acknowledged by all supreme Great Saints of that era.

...

After Black Light Great Saint entered the Xuanhuang Universe.

A large number of Chaos Venerables instantly became excited, quickly teleporting into the Xuanhuang Universe.

However, still quite a few Chaos Venerables did not act, refraining from rushing into the Xuanhuang Universe.

"This Postnatal Universe is indeed extraordinary, but no matter how extraordinary, what does it have to do with us? Ten Great Saints have entered, along with so many peak Venerables, no matter how many treasures there are, they will be divided up; going in, not only won’t we get treasures, we might even die."

Many Chaos Venerables were very clear, Lin Yuan and the four Great Saints including Black Light Great Saint made many Chaos Venerables realize the reality.

A significant number of Venerables, although aware of the Great Saints’ power, had seen confrontations among Great Saints, but had never encountered conflict like that among Black Light, Dual Origin, and the other four Great Saints.

Usually, Great Saints rarely clash, especially the strong ones.

Lin Yuan, Black Light, and the other four Great Saints’ conflict made some Venerables deeply aware of their own weakness.

If it were just ordinary Great Saints, going in might offer a chance to fish in troubled waters, but against such formidable Great Saints? How could they fish in troubled waters?

Not to mention many peak Venerables have also entered.

"Even though I won’t go in, witnessing a confrontation among Great Saints of this level has been worthwhile."

"Indeed, we’ve seen images of battles between Great Saints in the past, but images can never compare to the impact of witnessing the real scene."

"That last Great Saint that appeared, make sure you remember him. If you encounter him in the future, under no circumstances should you provoke him."

Many Chaos Venerables felt quite relieved. After abandoning the quest to enter the Xuanhuang Universe, they naturally felt no pressure.

"That’s right, I have already passed on the footage of the recent battle to many of my friends, so they can be cautious as well."

A Chaos Venerable spoke up.

This is the reason the reputation of the Chaos Great Saint will inevitably spread throughout various Void Domains.

As long as they take action once and are noticed by other Chaos Venerables, the news will be spread widely.

Someone like Lin Yuan, who possesses the mighty strength of a Great Saint, yet has no related information or intelligence available, is rare. He can only be categorized as a Great Saint from ancient times, with all the beings who knew his intelligence perishing in the distant past.

...

Further away.

In a twisted space-time, several colossal consciousnesses were watching from afar.

These vast consciousnesses faintly manifested in different forms—there was a giant eye, an ancient and mottled altar, and a long knife broken into two pieces...

"This person... has not evolved a path of Chaos Power, yet his strength can rival that of a Chaos Realm perfection—remarkable, truly remarkable..."

The soul of the ancient and mottled Altar Spirit emitted waves, expressing amazement.

They are all special existences, not regarded as normal lifeforms, means left by Thirteenth Layer beings, birthed with intelligence. Through countless Cosmic Eras, they have witnessed untold numbers of Chaos Great Saints and Legendary Great Saints.

But it is the first time seeing someone like Lin Yuan.

It’s not that Lin Yuan’s strength is exceptionally powerful, but that a lifeform who has not even mastered Chaos evolutionary power can fight evenly with those perfected in the Chaos Realm.

The higher one’s level of insight, the more one can perceive the difficulty in this.

Why can those perfected in the Chaos Realm stand far above Venerables? Essentially, both exist in the Chaos Realm, but the former has evolved its own path power from Chaos.

This is a qualitative change.

It’s also the prerequisite for impacting the Thirteenth Layer.

"I can feel his foundation is incredibly terrifying. Could he have obtained some Thirteenth Layer inheritance?"

The broken long knife also emitted soul waves, Thirteenth Layer inheritance? For Twelfth Layer beings, it’s something one may never come across, even many Chaos Great Saints, and Legendary Great Saints haven’t heard of it.

But in the eyes of these special existences, a Thirteenth Layer inheritance is no secret.

Some even know the locations of certain Thirteenth Layer inheritances, many ancient and mighty Thirteenth Layer beings, when in the mood, will leave their inheritances intentionally.

It’s just that these inheritances involve certain Thirteenth Layer Temporal Lifeforms. Even if they know, these special beings dare not leak it to the outside.

You must know, Thirteenth Layer beings can see through the past and future, almost no secret can be hidden from them.

Once they know their inheritance has been leaked and obtained by others taking advantage of it, even if these beings are the handiwork of some Thirteenth Layer Lifeform, they won’t meet a good end. At the very least, their current consciousness will be erased.

"Even if he obtained a Thirteenth Layer inheritance, to practice and reach such a level is also very difficult." The ancient mottled Altar Spirit said.

Although a Thirteenth Layer inheritance indeed has extremely defiant effects, to master it? It’s equally difficult, and some Thirteenth Layer inheritances might not even be acquirable at all, entirely belonging to the creator’s theoretical speculation.

"No matter what, it’s estimated that in the not-too-distant future, this Chaos Void will have another Invincible Great Saint."

The broken long knife spoke.

Upon hearing this.

The other consciousnesses did not voice any objection.

With the current strength Lin Yuan has demonstrated, once he evolves Chaos-exclusive powers, becoming a Legendary Great Saint is inevitable, and further refining that Thirteenth Layer inheritance to a certain height, he will assuredly become an Invincible Great Saint.

"How long has it been since a new Invincible Great Saint appeared in my Chaos Void? Who was the last Invincible Great Saint? Wasn’t it ’Mo Yu’?"

The ancient mottled Altar Spirit casually said.

Unlike the other consciousnesses involved in the conversation, the Eye of Myriad Laws, which presented as a giant eye, did not say much.

"This Galaxy, his strength is much stronger than I imagined." The Eye of Myriad Laws was secretly astonished, for he knew Lin Yuan better than the other special existences.

...

As time passed.

The battle outside the Xuanhuang Universe quickly spread across various Void Domains.

Especially the contest among Lin Yuan, Dual Origin, Black Light, and Wild Barbarian four Great Saints, which made many Chaos Venerables tremble with fear.

It was evident that the strength of these four Great Saints surpasses the other six Great Saints by a considerable margin.

Ancient Ming Chaos Continent.

The Ancient Ming Venerable also received combat footage from outside the Xuanhuang Universe.

"So that’s a Chaos Great Saint..." The Ancient Ming Venerable was quite emotional. "Were Nine Phoenix Great Saint and Shadow Demon Great Saint there too?"

The Ancient Ming Venerable immediately recognized these two Great Saints. Not long ago, because of the battle between these two Great Saints, the Chaos Continent where he resided was forced to relocate here.

"The strength of these four Great Saints..." The Ancient Ming Venerable was trembling internally upon seeing the four Great Saints’ contest, though he quickly noticed something amiss.

"Why does that last Great Saint look so much like ’Galaxy’?" The Ancient Ming Venerable was shocked.
